title: Nightstand mini drawer and organizer
author: nogitsune
description:
The mini four-drawer, organizer, and book stand in one.

The drawer and organizer are separated models so, only organizer without drawer may be also.

**Additional Components Required**

- Four M3 x 4mm Brass hot melt inserts (4mm OD)
- Four M3 x 10mm socket head cap screws
- Optional: eight 3 mm (D) x 2 mm (H) magnets as drawer locks

**Additional Tools**

- Heat-Set Insert Installation Tool

Warnings!

- **Do not use countersunk head screws!** Use only screws with a flat head on the bottom.

Notes

- **Brass hot melt inserts must not protrude above the surface.**

storage.note: 3MF files are stored as .3mf.xz to stay under GitHub's 100MB limit. Decompress with `xz -d -k <file>` before use; SHA-256 is computed on the compressed file.
